output.summary: The problem is that errors in processing actual meter reads produce incorrect bills, driving the increase in dispute volume tied to actual reads (E-01, E-03). This was established by observing that dispute ticket volume doubled from June–July to August–September (E-01) and that disputed bills are more often linked to actual than estimated reads (E-03). The released solution includes monitoring actual read processing in the billing database and enriching dispute ticket triage with lagging route information (W-MONITOR-ACTUAL-READ-PROCESSI, W-IMPROVE-DISPUTE-TICKET-TRIAG). The release decision is HOLD because the billing import/validation rule set (DA-RULES) has unknown completeness (DA-RULES) and the Layer 1 safety predicate/verification was not established. Known limitations are that the release only monitors and triages; it does not fix the billing import/validation rule set identified as the error source, and it does not disclose that monitoring alone does not correct underlying errors (release.limitations).
